newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK MUTUAL FUND ASSETS REACH 114BLN DRS JAN-APRIL.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK MUTUAL FUND ASSETS REACH 114BLN DRS JAN-APRIL.

text.p: Assets under management of Greek private Xiosbank reached 114 billion drachmas growing 47.75 percent versus a market average of 29.94 percent from the begining of the year to April 30, it said in a statement.

Xiosgrowth rated second among equity funds returning 49.86 percent from the begining of the year to the end of April versus an average 41.21 percent by its investment class. Its assets rose 371.53 percent to 3.179,5 billion drachmas in the same period.

Xioscapital money market fund returned 3.48 percent and its total assets amounted to 46.4 billion drachmas by end April. Xiosfixed returned 4.10 percent and its total assets grew 128.8 percent to 50.2 billion drachmas at the end of April.

Xiosmark registered a return of 0.86 percent from the begining of the year to the end of April with total assets of 3.9 billion drachmas and Xiosinvest international fund 92.24 percent and 10.1 billion drachmas respectively. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
